title: Week 2
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. This week is lighter because it uses up what is left from week 1.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Peanut butter and hummus are often made in plants that also handle tree nuts. If your allergy is strict, check the labels for a 'may contain tree nuts' line.
weekendNote: Festival days. Leftovers waiting for you: a portion of tikka masala and one bowl of chili. Two chili bowls and two carnitas portions stay frozen for week 3.
snacks: Hummus with cucumber and pepper strips

mon.heads: Lunch comes straight from Sunday's prep. Dinner uses the carnitas you moved to the fridge Sunday night.

wed.heads: Tonight, move Friday's chili bowl from the freezer to the fridge.

thu.heads: Tonight, marinate the tikka chicken for tomorrow. Five minutes.

prep.title: Sunday batch prep
prep.makes: 8 bowls of turkey chili, 4 portions of shawarma chicken, a tray of roasted vegetables, garlic yogurt sauce, rice, 3 jars of oats, 6 eggs
steps: Brown the turkey for 6 minutes and start the chili in the crock pot (low 7 to 8 hours or high 4).
Heat the oven to 425°F. Coat the chicken thighs in the shawarma marinade.
Roast the chicken on one sheet pan and the vegetables on another for 22 to 25 minutes.
Cook 2 cups of rice.
Make the garlic yogurt sauce. Quick-pickle half a red onion in lemon and salt, and chop the cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix 3 jars of overnight oats. Air-fry 6 eggs at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Slice the chicken. Pack 3 shawarma bowls and keep 1 portion of chicken and a cup of vegetables for Tuesday's wraps.
When the chili is done, keep 4 bowls in the fridge and freeze 3: one for Friday and two for week 3.
Move one carnitas portion from the freezer to the fridge for Monday.

prep.title: Thursday night
prep.makes: Marinated chicken for Friday's tikka masala
steps: Toss the chicken pieces with the yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, the paprika and ½ tsp salt.
Cover and refrigerate until tomorrow's dinner.

turkey-chili.name: Big-batch turkey and sweet potato chili
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Put everything in the crock pot and stir.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours or high 4 hours.
Keep 4 bowls in the fridge. Freeze 3: one for Friday and two for week 3.
turkey-chili.tip: One pot that becomes Wednesday's lunch, chili night for two, Thursday's chili mac, Friday's lunch and two lunches in week 3.

shawarma-chicken.name: Sheet-pan chicken shawarma
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan.
Stir the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, spices, salt and oil together and coat the chicken.
Spread the thighs flat on the pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes, until the edges char.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice into 4 portions.

roast-veg.name: Roasted peppers, zucchini and red onion
steps: Toss everything with the oil, cumin and salt.
Roast on a sheet pan at 425°F for 22 to 25 minutes, alongside the chicken.
Cool and store in one container.

garlic-yogurt.name: Garlic yogurt sauce
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber in a towel until dry.
Stir it into the yogurt with the garlic, lemon, dill and salt.
Keep in a jar. It is good for 5 days.

pb-oats.name: Peanut butter banana overnight oats
steps: Mash one banana in a bowl and stir in the milk, yogurt, peanut butter, honey, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in the oats.
Split across 3 jars and top with the sliced banana.
Refrigerate overnight. They keep 4 days.

breakfast-tacos.name: Black bean breakfast tacos
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, then wrap them in a towel.
Spray the skillet and wilt the spinach with the beans for 1 minute.
Add the whisked eggs and salt and scramble gently until just set.
Fill the tortillas and top with cheese and salsa.
breakfast-tacos.tip: Good fuel before Tuesday and Thursday pickleball.

hb-eggs.name: Air-fryer hard-boiled eggs
steps: Put the eggs straight into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 270°F for 15 minutes.
Move them to a bowl of ice water for 5 minutes, then refrigerate.

shawarma-bowl.name: Chicken shawarma bowl
steps: Toss the cucumber and tomatoes with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Build each bowl on spinach and rice with chicken, roasted vegetables, salad, pickled onion and hummus.
Pack the garlic yogurt on the side.
shawarma-bowl.tip: Built from Sunday's chicken, vegetables and sauce. Eat the third one by Thursday.

shawarma-wraps.name: Shawarma naan wraps
steps: Warm the chicken and vegetables in a skillet for 3 minutes.
Warm the naan in the same pan for 30 seconds a side.
Spread with hummus, add spinach, chicken and vegetables, then spoon on the garlic yogurt and fold.
shawarma-wraps.tip: Ten minutes after Tuesday pickleball, all from Sunday's prep.

carnitas-quesadillas.name: Carnitas and pepper quesadillas
steps: Sear the pepper and onion in the dry cast iron for 5 minutes, then crisp the carnitas alongside for 3 minutes.
Lay 2 tortillas in the pan, add cheese, the filling, more cheese and the top tortillas.
Press with a spatula and cook 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
Cut into quarters and serve with salsa, yogurt and cilantro.
carnitas-quesadillas.tip: Free dinner from last week's freezer. Two carnitas portions stay frozen for week 3.

chili-lunch.name: Turkey chili lunch bowl
steps: Microwave the chili 3 minutes, stirring halfway.
Top with cheese, green onion and a spoon of yogurt.

chili-night.name: Chili night with a toppings bar
steps: Warm the chili in a pot.
Spray the tortilla strips and air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes until crunchy.
Set out the cheese, yogurt, green onion, cilantro and strips so everyone tops their own.
chili-night.tip: Dinner for two from Sunday's pot.

chili-mac.name: Turkey chili mac
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water and drain.
Stir in the chili and warm through.
Fold in the cheese until melty and top with green onion.
chili-mac.tip: Comfort food after Thursday pickleball, from Sunday's pot.

tikka-masala.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: The chicken marinated last night in the yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, the paprika and ½ tsp salt.
Start the rice. Sear the chicken in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes and set it aside.
Cook the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin and the rest of the garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes, then stir in the coconut milk.
Return the chicken and simmer 10 minutes until thick. Salt to taste.
Warm the naan and serve over rice with cilantro.
tikka-masala.tip: This week's new one, and a dinner for two. Coconut milk stands in for cream, so it stays lighter.
